title: Advance Seat Selection Rules — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Ancillary product rule — seats on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** Advance seat selection follows the fare brand's seat entitlement:

| Entitlement | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Paid only | Every advance seat is purchased; a standard seat is otherwise assigned free at check-in |
| Standard included | Standard seats are free; preferred or extra-legroom seats are purchased |
| Extra-legroom included | Preferred and extra-legroom seats are free |
| Premium cabin included | The passenger sits in the premium cabin and no main-cabin seat fee applies |

## Pricing clause

The former clause setting the seat fee per passenger per flight segment by the kind of seat purchased and the segment distance — the short-segment price for segments up to and including the segment length threshold and the long-segment price for longer segments, of the fare brand's standard, preferred or extra-legroom seat fee — is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current seat price basis.

## Conditions in force

- A seat can be purchased only while the ticket is ticketed or partially flown.
- When the passenger's Summit membership tier includes the seat in the loyalty program's terms (complimentary preferred seating or complimentary extra-legroom seating), the seat is assigned at no charge and no fee entry is written.
- The fare-brand inclusion and the elite inclusion never combine into a credit, and the lowest applicable price, zero where either includes the seat, is the one charged.
- A seat already confirmed on the segment must be released before another is purchased; the released seat's fee is not refunded unless the fee-refund rule applies.
- A seat Crestline later fails to provide is refunded under the fee-refund rule.

*Hypothetical case.* A Crestline Main Plus passenger already has preferred and extra-legroom seats free under the fare brand; an elite inclusion on top of it creates no credit.

superseded_clauses: A seat fee is charged per passenger per flight segment, chosen by the service_type purchased and the segment_miles: segments up to and including segment_length_threshold_miles use the short-segment price and longer segments use the long-segment price of standard_seat_fee, preferred_seat_fee or extra_legroom_seat_fee for the fare brand.
